research_notes: Blocked after official roster, personal and alumni biographies, historical NITV sources and targeted full-time searches. Need individual hours/contracts, dates within reported years, 1994 ABC overlap resolution and inter-parliamentary work coverage.

Official two legal-employment spells supersede alumni biography's broad articles 1998–2002 description. Alumni page also misdates a Port Arthur award and calls Corangamite a state seat; those claims are not adopted.

NITV government funding and later SBS ownership do not prove government control during Henderson's 2008–09 tenure. Recover contemporary constitution/control evidence if reassessing the nonprofit exclusion.
No job title or long career span establishes full-time status. Year-only labels remain intact; headlines unknown, not zero.

Follow-up2026-10-02: replaced sole reliance on error-prone alumni chronology for3AW with dated government transcript27 May1994 and broadcaster archive22 June1994; January1994 Australia’s Most Wanted announcement is an additional chronology anchor.

Targeted historical media appointment, Clifton, NITV, Kudos and full-time searches did not supply exact contracts or individual hours. Unrelated overseas health/PR/academic namesakes and staff recruitment advertisements excluded. Women Australia entry open returned URL not accessible via this tool; other independent sources used.

Follow-up2026-10-03: historical schedules place Henderson on ABC Holiday23 August1993 and the Victorian7.30 Report20 March1995; an ABC archive identifies her as a7.30 Report reporter in1996. These observations sit either side of her documented1994 Seven/3AW work and materially refine the chronology, but do not establish whether she resigned, took leave or held concurrent contracts. A sworn2024 affidavit confirms the later sequence Allens to News Corporation to own consultancy to Network Ten/NITV management, but supplies no dates or hours, so official year labels remain unchanged.

Next leads: ABC staff/annual records distinguishing pre1994 and1995 return spells; Seven production contract; archived3AW appointment notices; legal-firm/NewsCorp and consultancy employer biographies; pre-SBS NITV constitution. Do not turn broadcast observations or programme schedules into full-time duration.
